title: Spanish American wars of independence
summary: Napoleon's invasion of Spain in 1808 set off political upheaval in Spain's American colonies, and wars of independence followed across South America. Leaders such as Simón Bolívar and José de San Martín emerged, and the revolutionaries ended Spanish colonial rule on the continent. Between 1810 and 1822, fifteen Latin American colonies declared independence from Spain.

uncertainty.note: EBSCO dates the conflict 1808–1826; the State Department museum notes declarations of independence between 1810 and 1822.

where.modern_name: Caracas, Venezuela (proxy pin for a continent-wide conflict)

importance.justification: Ended Spanish colonial rule across mainland Spanish America and produced many new independent states.
